[2026-08-19T22:23:19.073Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-08-19T22:23:19.073Z] [arbiter] This is one of the Aetherkin, then — not a story after all. The dead of old Tartaria, still walking because the Aether in them never stopped.
[2026-08-19T22:23:19.074Z] [world] In life it was a bell-ringer, shoulders rounded from a rope pulled ten thousand times — the set of the jaw is close enough to a portrait you saw once in a flooded hall. Something you stirred woke the Aetherstone that held them; now they're awake and out.
[2026-08-19T22:23:19.074Z] [world] It flinches from you and puts its back to the wall, hands raised — not a hunter, just something frightened that has forgotten everything except how to be afraid.
[2026-08-19T22:23:19.074Z] [world] You push south. The wind has a voice today; mostly it just murmurs old syllables you don't quite catch.
